testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Cyanocobalamin 0.1% in WS (UV maximum wavelength)
testDefinitions.notes: 1.0 g dissolved in water to 100 mL, centrifuged and filtered. Scanned between 260 nm and 610 nm; maximum must be at 361 ± 2 nm (spec 359-363 nm). Measurement test, analyst enters observed wavelength of maximum absorption in nm (UV workflow does not record wavelength as a result; CATALOG.md rule 6; source: Cyanocobalamine 0.1% in WS__STM Cyanocobalamine 0.1% in WS 1-2 without micro.txt:30).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of Cyanocobalamin 0.1% in WS (UV A1%)
testDefinitions.notes: Weigh ~1.0 g into 100 mL volumetric flask, make up to volume with water, filter and centrifuge; measure absorbance at 361 nm. Vit. B12 content (%) = (A x 100) / (207 x W), where 207 is E1% 1cm. BP specification NLT 0.1% (source: Cyanocobalamine 0.1% in WS__STM Cyanocobalamine 0.1% in WS 1-2 without micro.txt:32).

testDefinitions.notes: TLC on silica gel plate. Test solution: 0.6 g in 50 mL ethanol (30% V/V). Reference solution: 0.5 g fructose, 0.5 g glucose, 0.1 g sucrose in 100 mL ethanol (30% V/V). Mobile phase: water : acetonitrile (13:87 V/V). Apply 5 µL as bands; develop 3 times over 15 cm; dry in warm air. Spray with diphenylamine-aniline-phosphoric acid reagent, heat at 100-105 °C for 5-10 min. Chromatogram conforms to reference zone sequence (fructose intense brown, glucose intense greyish-blue, sucrose brown, 2-3 brownish-grey zones). BP Appendix III A (source: Purified Honey - Micro__STM Purified Honey.txt:31-39).

Take water content from refractive index (Table 2051.-1). Dissolve honey equivalent to 5.0 g dry solids in 25 mL water, add Carrez reagents (0.5 mL 150 g/L potassium ferrocyanide, 0.5 mL 300 g/L zinc acetate), dilute to 50.0 mL, filter. Test solution 5.0 mL filtrate + 5.0 mL water; reference solution 5.0 mL filtrate + 5.0 mL 2.0 g/L sodium hydrogen sulfite. Measure absorbance at 284 nm and 336 nm within 60 min. HMF (ppm) = (A1 - A2) x D x 149.7. Measurement test, analyst enters calculated HMF in ppm (two-wavelength subtraction not calculated by UV workflow; CATALOG.md rule 6; source: Purified Honey - Micro__STM Purified Honey.txt:70).
